update.confirmBody: Perception and rules pause for a few minutes during the update; the page reconnects by itself. Update now?
update.upgradingHint: Keep this page open — it refreshes when it's done.
update.slowHint: The first update downloads a larger package and may take a few minutes.
update.runInBackground: Continue in background (tap the version at the top left to reopen)
update.timeoutHint: It may still be running in the background — refresh in a moment to check. If it won't open, contact your administrator.
update.failedHint: You're still on the previous version. Refresh to check; you can retry later. If it keeps failing, contact your administrator.
update.footerUpdateAria: New version {{version}} available — click to upgrade
update.devDeploy: This is a source checkout — run git pull and restart (one-tap update is for releases only)
update.checkFailed: Couldn't check for updates right now (can't reach the update server)
update.authError: Your session expired during the update. Refresh and sign in to check the result.
update.statusError: Couldn't get update progress: {{msg}}. It may still be running — refresh shortly.
